name: rosetta-n-queens-problem
code:
use default

safe(queens: List[int], row: int, column: int) -> bool =>
    queens |> index()
        |> all((placed_row, placed_column) =>
            placed_column != column /\
                placed_row - placed_column != row - column /\
                placed_row + placed_column != row + column)

placements(n: int, queens: List[int]) -> Pipe[LIST[int]] is
    if queens.count == n then
        yield queens
    else
        for column in 0..n do
            if safe(queens, queens.count, column) then
                let extended = LIST(queens)
                extended.add(column)
                yield in placements(n, extended)
            fi
        od
    fi
si

for n in 1::8 do
    write_line("{n} by {n}: {placements(n, LIST()) |> count()} solutions")
od

write_line("an 8 queens solution:")

if let first_solution = placements(8, LIST()) |> first() then
    first_solution |> index()
    |> each(((row, column)) =>
        write_line(
            (0..8)
                |> map(c => if c == column then "Q" else "." fi)
                |> join(" ")))
fi
